source_title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged despite inflation in the US - Al Jazeera
source_excerpt:
The United States Federal Reserve is set to hold interest rates steady in its final monetary policy decision before the US midterm elections.
The central bank will maintain rates at 3.75-4 percent, following a 10-2 vote, in line with expectations.

CME FedWatch, which tracks the likelihood of monetary policy decisions, indicated that there was more than a 90 percent chance rates would remain unchanged.
“Economic activity is expanding at a strong pace,” the Fed said in its press release announcing the decision on Wednesday. “While uncertainty remains elevated owing, in part, to geopolitical developments, domestic spending has been resilient. Productivity growth is strong, and capital investment is robust. Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little.”
The Fed noted how inflation continues to rise.
It also added, “The accumulation of more information will help the Committee determine the policy stance appropriate to ensure a timely return of inflation to the Committee’s 2 percent goal.”
The most recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) report showed the annual inflation rate increasing to 3.7 percent in September , up from 3.4 percent in August, with energy prices largely accounting for the monthly surge.
There were signs earlier this month that the central bank would maintain benchmark interest rates, with the Fed’s chair for supervision, Michelle Bowman, advocating a “wait and see” approach.
“I don’t feel any urgency for taking further action at this point,” she said at this month’s International Monetary Fund-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, Thailand. “We really need to take some time and understand how things will evolve.”
The decision comes before Thursday’s release of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index report, which is used by the central bank to assess inflation and inform its decisions.
Today’s Fed announcement follows an interest-rate hike rise last month, amid surging inflation – the first increase by the central bank since July 2023. The move drew criticism from US President Donald Trump, who has repeatedly pressed the Fed to cut rates since taking office. At the time, he wrote on Truth Social that “interest rates in the United States should be 1% or less.”
The Fed’s next monetary policy meeting is scheduled for December 8-9, when it will give its final rate decision of the year.
Current forecasts point to a quarter-point interest rate increase.

## फेड की मौद्रिक नीति का निर्णय
अमेरिकी फेडरल रिजर्व ने ब्याज दरों को 3.75-4 प्रतिशत के दायरे में बनाए रखने का निर्णय लिया है। 10-2 के बहुमत से लिए गए इस फैसले ने बाजार की उन उम्मीदों को सही साबित किया है, जिसमें CME FedWatch ने दरें स्थिर रहने की 90 प्रतिशत से अधिक संभावना जताई थी। यह निर्णय अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले लिया गया अंतिम नीतिगत फैसला है।

## आर्थिक दृष्टिकोण और महंगाई
केंद्रीय बैंक ने अपने आधिकारिक बयान में अमेरिकी अर्थव्यवस्था की स्थिति के बारे में ये मुख्य बिंदु बताए हैं:
* आर्थिक गतिविधियां तेजी से बढ़ रही हैं।
* भू-राजनीतिक अनिश्चितताओं के बावजूद घरेलू खर्च लचीला बना हुआ है।
* उत्पादकता में वृद्धि और पूंजी निवेश मजबूत है।
* नौकरियों में वृद्धि कार्यबल के अनुरूप है और बेरोजगारी दर स्थिर है।

हालांकि, समिति ने बढ़ती महंगाई पर चिंता व्यक्त की है। हालिया उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, वार्षिक मुद्रास्फीति दर अगस्त के 3.4 प्रतिशत से बढ़कर सितंबर में 3.7 प्रतिशत हो गई है, जिसका मुख्य कारण ऊर्जा की कीमतों में उछाल है। फेड ने कहा है कि भविष्य के निर्णय इस बात पर निर्भर करेंगे कि मुद्रास्फीति को 2 प्रतिशत के लक्ष्य तक कैसे लाया जाए।

## आगे की राह
अधिकारियों ने सतर्क रुख अपनाने का सुझाव दिया है। इस महीने बैंकॉक में IMF-विश्व बैंक की बैठकों के दौरान, फेड की पर्यवेक्षण अध्यक्ष मिशेल बोमन ने 'प्रतीक्षा करें और देखें' की रणनीति का समर्थन करते हुए कहा कि फिलहाल किसी भी तत्काल कार्रवाई की जल्दबाजी नहीं है।

बाजार अब गुरुवार को आने वाली पर्सनल कंजम्पशन एक्सपेंडिचर (PCE) रिपोर्ट पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर रहा है। फेड की साल की आखिरी बैठक 8-9 दिसंबर को निर्धारित है, जिसमें मौजूदा अनुमानों के अनुसार तिमाही-प्रतिशत ब्याज दर में वृद्धि की संभावना जताई जा रही है।

en_body:
## Fed Monetary Policy Decision
The United States Federal Reserve has announced its decision to maintain interest rates at the current range of 3.75-4 percent. This choice, supported by a 10-2 vote, aligns with widespread market expectations reflected by CME FedWatch data, which had suggested a greater than 90 percent probability of such an outcome. This decision marks the final policy meeting ahead of the US midterm elections.

## Economic Outlook and Inflation
In its official statement, the central bank characterized the US economy as follows:
* Economic activity is expanding at a strong pace.
* Domestic spending remains resilient despite geopolitical uncertainties.
* Productivity growth and capital investment continue to show robustness.
* Job gains are consistent with workforce participation, keeping the unemployment rate steady.

However, the Committee acknowledged ongoing challenges regarding inflation. The most recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) report indicated that the annual inflation rate climbed to 3.7 percent in September, up from 3.4 percent in August, largely driven by energy costs. The Fed emphasized that future decisions will depend on incoming data to ensure inflation returns to its 2 percent target.

## Future Considerations
Officials have advocated for a cautious approach. Earlier in October, Fed Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman suggested a "wait and see" strategy during the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, noting that there is no immediate urgency for further action.

Investors are now looking toward the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index, set for release on Thursday. The Federal Reserve's final meeting of the year is scheduled for December 8-9, where current forecasts anticipate a potential quarter-point rate increase.
en_title: US Federal Reserve Holds Interest Rates Steady Amid Persistent Inflation
